decisions.reason: The fifteen-day program needs little dedicated investment and still fits the firm's fast-delivery positioning, but after dropping the 72-hour program it overlaps with the broader express line D, so folding it in remains a real possibility.

The firm launched the EI2 60-C5-S200 exterior door publicly at BAU, it carries costly European approval and extends the core Teckentrup 62 system, so the investment and visible commitment strongly favor persisting.
The multi-model express line has its own page and is the firm's main vehicle for fast delivery, a commitment that withdrawing the 72-hour program has made even more important to justify.

The digital ordering and services platform represents substantial development investment and is central to the announced service-oriented direction, so weak uptake would be read as temporary start-up difficulty.
The fire and smoke protection door belongs to the certified core safety portfolio, and its approval costs and regulatory demand make withdrawal unlikely.
